sidebar_extra.houston_pilot_desc: Downtown / Buffalo Bayou Corridor — Real GIS & Terrain Integration

guided_demo.s1_desc: Explore the 1.07 km² Downtown Houston / Buffalo Bayou pilot study area. Inspect the verified 1m LiDAR bare-earth DEM elevation raster, topographic hillshade, and City of Houston storm sewer infrastructure layers in the left sidebar.
guided_demo.s2_desc: Review the rainfall forcing inputs. Select synthetic design storm presets (10mm to 100mm/hr) in the sidebar or inspect the M2 gauge ingestion pipeline (highlighting live feed UNAVAILABLE vs. synthetic test fixture UNVERIFIED).
guided_demo.s3_desc: Run the M5 2D hydrodynamic screening model across a 90-minute storm timeline. Observe ponding depths (SIM-01 5-class ramp) accumulating in low-lying topographic depressions, clearly labeled MODELLED and UNVALIDATED.
guided_demo.s4_desc: Activate M6 Dynamic Hydraulic Loading to evaluate storm sewer capacity under active runoff. Color-coded conduits reveal Normal, High Loading, and Capacity Exceeded pipes, plus upstream/downstream network trace.
guided_demo.s5_desc: Compare M7 flood-aware navigation profiles between Origin (A) and Destination (B): Drainage-Informed, Shortest Path, and Low-EWSI routes, evaluating water depth exposure and impassable (>0.30m) road segments.
guided_demo.s6_desc: Switch to the M8 interactive WebGL 3D Terrain & Flood Viewer. Orbit and zoom across the vertically exaggerated Buffalo Bayou relief with draped M5 water surfaces and 3D stormwater conduit overlays.
guided_demo.s7_desc: Toggle the M9 ML Surrogate Engine (RandomForest trained on synthetic M5 grids) for sub-second flood depth inference. Notice the mandatory SYNTHETIC SURROGATE warning banner and scientific provenance badges.
guided_demo.s8_desc: Review the Data Source & Quality Governance registry and M3 Validation Readiness ledger. Every dataset and model output preserves strict SYNTHETIC, MODELLED, ASSUMED, and UNVALIDATED guardrails.
